ev.q: Two siblings aged 5 and 15 years from Connecticut were hospitalized with petechial rash, oral mucositis, and severe thrombocytopenia
Whole blood mercury concentrations for patients A and B were 315 μ g/L and 518 μ g/L, respectively

What is added by this report? Two siblings, aged 5 and 15 years, experienced severe thrombocytopenia after elemental mercury vapor exposure.
